_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractual Shipping Documentation
summary: The Contractual Shipping Documentation DID provides the Government with the information needed to help Item Management inspect and manage the program.
use_relationship: The Contractual Shipping Documentation DID will provide the Government with the information needed to help the Item Management inspect and manage the program.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractual Shipping Documentation shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractual Shipping Documentation shall contain and identify:

children.title: List of applicable Schedule "A" numbers, nomenclature and quantity.
A complete inventory of all GFE provided at a level of detail that includes discrete individual cabinets, components, interface devices, kits and other individually packaged items.
List of all applicable Engineering Change Proposals (ECP) changes.
Itemized list of all Shipped Short items at the Schedule "A" level along with the estimated delivery dates.
Disposition instructions for any material that the shipyard is expected to return, such as shipping reels or containers.

preparation_instructions.title: The Contractual Shipping Documentation shall also include:

children.title: Carrier Name and assigned Tracking Number (Pro-number) and phone number.
Date the GFE was shipped and estimated arrival date to the shipyard for each shipment.
All loose parts and the contents of each kit shall be listed in detail to show accurate inventory at the shipyard receiving warehouse.
